ValidationRule.description: Coverage allocations may not total more than 100%; lower totals are allowed so a split can be built one row at a time (see Allocation_Complete__c). Total_Allocation__c is a Percent (100% = 1.0), hence the x100.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Technology Coverage Allocation Percent values on this Agreement cannot total more than 100%. To re-split, lower an existing allocation before raising another.
